clips.title: The story
paras: Along Durotar’s western road, Conscript of the Horde sends recruits toward the Barrens. Takrin Pathseeker watches beyond Razor Hill and gives them a letter for Kargal Battlescar, whose outpost guards the crossing.

After proving your strength around Razor Hill, you are called west to serve the wider Horde. Takrin Pathseeker watches the road out of Durotar for his friend, veteran Kargal Battlescar. He gives capable travelers a recruitment letter to carry across the Southfury River. For a recruit, the letter marks a first formal assignment beyond the orcs’ new homeland.

Kargal Battlescar holds the outpost beyond the bridge, between Durotar’s red canyons and the dry Barrens. He gathers recruits to guard the frontier, where centaur, quilboar, and Alliance expeditions test the border. The Horde needs more than guards there: raw manpower is being sent to the settlement of the Crossroads.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Listen, my good friend Kargal needs some new recruits for Barrens duty. I know you want to do what's right for the Horde. Well, this is your chance.
Take this recruitment letter to Kargal and see if he'll sign it.

clips.title: Progress
paras: What do you want, pup? If you're not here for recruitment, I don't have time for you.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Oh, so Takrin sent you? He's an excellent scout, I'm not sure what I'd do without him.
I'll sign your recruitment letter, but what we really need is someone at the Crossroads.
